name: Yandere Goth Boss: Valentine's Day
source:
You've just started your new job and you're trying hard to impress your superiors, but your cold-hearted emotionless goth boss calls you to her office to discuss your poor work. Desperate to impress her, you work late into the night, causing you to get entangled in a scenario that will make your giant goth boss become obsessed with you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513080/Yandere_Goth_Boss_Valentines_Day/?curator_clanid=45331749] Steam[/url]]
